title: 瓦爾霍爾油田
subcategoryTitle: 固定式平台與海上油田
subcategoryTitleEn: Fixed platforms and offshore oil fields
summary: 瓦爾霍爾是挪威政府持續記錄的海上油田；以成熟設施的沉降接口、荷載與量測趨勢建立本課。本課依序分析舊新設施相對位移、重量與承載面積、連接件循環負荷、不同年代壁厚資料、高程基準可追溯性，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Valhall is documented by the Norwegian government; this case studies mature-facility settlement interfaces, loads and measurement trends. The course analyses relative movement of old and new facilities, weight and bearing area, cyclic loading of connections, thickness records from different eras, traceability of elevation datums, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 舊新設施相對位移、重量與承載面積、連接件循環負荷
v31FocusEn: Relative movement of old and new facilities; Weight and bearing area; Cyclic loading of connections

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：瓦爾霍爾油田
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Valhall oil field
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「舊新設施相對位移」與「重量與承載面積」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Relative movement of old and new facilities" and "Weight and bearing area": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「舊新設施相對位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Relative movement of old and new facilities" is correct?
options: 均勻沉降與差異沉降造成的結構效應不同；兩支承點的相對位移除以距離可形成一階轉角指標。
整個平台下沉一樣多，就等於所有接口沒有位移問題。
平均壓力低就代表平台基礎的所有極限狀態都合格。
optionsEn: Uniform and differential settlement have different structural consequences.
Equal overall platform subsidence means every interface is free of displacement problems.
Low average pressure proves every foundation limit state passes.
quiz.explanation: 均勻沉降與差異沉降造成的結構效應不同；兩支承點的相對位移除以距離可形成一階轉角指標。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform and differential settlement have different structural consequences. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 舊新設施相對位移：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Relative movement of old and new facilities: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「舊新設施相對位移」如何決定「瓦爾霍爾油田」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative movement of old and new facilities” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Valhall oil field”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「舊新設施相對位移」。瓦爾霍爾是挪威政府持續記錄的海上油田；以成熟設施的沉降接口、荷載與量測趨勢建立本課。在「瓦爾霍爾油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。均勻沉降與差異沉降造成的結構效應不同；兩支承點的相對位移除以距離可形成一階轉角指標。這個幾何量不等於完整管線應力，仍須考慮柔性、支承摩擦、熱膨脹與連接位置。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Relative movement of old and new facilities”. Valhall is documented by the Norwegian government; this case studies mature-facility settlement interfaces, loads and measurement trends. In the teaching model for Valhall oil field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Uniform and differential settlement have different structural consequences. Relative support displacement divided by spacing gives a first-order rotation indicator. This geometric measure is not a full piping-stress result; flexibility, support friction, thermal expansion and connection locations remain important. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 舊新設施相對位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Relative movement of old and new facilities: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「舊新設施相對位移」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Relative movement of old and new facilities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：theta ≈ Δz/L；代入 dz = 0.06 m differential settlement、L = 20.7 m support spacing，得 2.90 mrad（「舊新設施相對位移」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dz 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: theta ≈ Δz/L; with dz = 0.06 m differential settlement, L = 20.7 m support spacing the result is 2.90 mrad (simplified exercise for Relative movement of old and new facilities; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dz by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dz 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.19 mrad（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dz by 10% changes the result to 3.19 mrad (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2.90 mrad（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dz 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2.90 mrad (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dz with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「舊新設施相對位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Relative movement of old and new facilities"?

針對「舊新設施相對位移」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Relative movement of old and new facilities”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

steps.title: 舊新設施相對位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative movement of old and new facilities: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「舊新設施相對位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative movement of old and new facilities” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「舊新設施相對位移」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用共同高程基準比較兩點量測，分開整體下沉與相對位移，再以簡圖確認轉角正負方向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Relative movement of old and new facilities”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Compare two support measurements against a common datum, separate overall subsidence from relative movement, and verify the rotation sign using a simple sketch. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 017-01 標記，圖表須寫明「瓦爾霍爾油田：教學假設」。提交共同基準、相對位移與接口清單，將幾何篩選與結構適用性判定分開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 017-01 and mark charts “Valhall oil field: teaching assumptions”. Submit the common datum, relative displacements and interface register, separating geometric screening from structural fitness decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「舊新設施相對位移」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Relative movement of old and new facilities” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「舊新設施相對位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Relative movement of old and new facilities" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 「舊新設施相對位移」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
平均壓力低就代表平台基礎的所有極限狀態都合格。
optionsEn: An error at “Relative movement of old and new facilities” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Low average pressure proves every foundation limit state passes.
quiz.explanation: 「舊新設施相對位移」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An error at “Relative movement of old and new facilities” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 舊新設施相對位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative movement of old and new facilities: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「舊新設施相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Relative movement of old and new facilities” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「舊新設施相對位移」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。兩點採用不同基準會製造假性傾斜；若只追蹤平台中心高度，可能漏掉連橋與管線接口之間的差異位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「瓦爾霍爾油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Relative movement of old and new facilities” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Different survey datums create false tilt; monitoring only the platform centre can miss relative movement at bridge and piping interfaces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Valhall oil field”.
